content: {"episode_id":"ep-05282","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"Reconsideration is requested for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), denied under PR-204 as not covered under the member’s current benefit plan. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and atherosclerotic heart disease. Given the intermittent symptoms and the need to correlate clinical events with underlying arrhythmias, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to provide continuous rhythm monitoring and event correlation."}
